question: Please help me find the names of top 5 players with the highest average runs per match in season 5, along with their batting averages.
sql:
SELECT p.player_name, ROUND(SUM(bs.runs_scored) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT b.match_id), 2) as avg_runs_per_match
FROM ball_by_ball b
JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id
JOIN player p ON p.player_id = b.striker
WHERE b.match_id IN (SELECT match_id FROM match WHERE season_id = 5)
GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name
ORDER BY avg_runs_per_match DESC
LIMIT 5
